explanation: Generated EXCLURAD input for the eta channel (e p -> e' p eta) with W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi=90 deg using beam energy 6.53 GeV (the default validated eta campaign energy). The vcut was set to -0.1 as requested; the negative value is intentional in EXCLURAD's input convention — line 7 of the input file comments 'negative -- v', meaning the integrator interprets negative vcut as switching to a different cut variable (typically the inelasticity nu or a related quantity) rather than the squared four-momentum transfer v. This is a valid but non-standard mode; results will differ from the default positive vcut=0.166 case. If the user intended 'no cut', vcut should be 0. The kinematic point itself passes all preflight checks (above eta threshold at 1.4861 GeV, within table coverage, cos(theta*)=0 avoids the pole issue). The lookup table file maid07-PPpi.tbl is NOT present in the working directory — the Fortran will fail to open it when run. It must be copied into the work directory before execution.
